title: Performance Measurement on Heterogeneous Processors with PAPI
problem: Heterogeneous processors with cores of different capabilities complicate performance analysis, and existing PAPI performance measurement library was not designed to handle varying core types and their distinct characteristics.
motivation: Heterogeneous cores are increasingly common from embedded ARM systems to emerging x86 desktop/server/HPC platforms, requiring updated performance measurement tools to support proper analysis.
method: The paper examines current Linux support for heterogeneous processors and documents problems encountered when adding heterogeneous processor support to PAPI. It identifies challenges in instrumenting performance counters across cores with differing capabilities and details solutions for extending PAPI's measurement infrastructure.
key_novelty: Extending PAPI to support performance measurement on heterogeneous processors by handling cores with different capabilities and characteristics.
contributions: Analysis of Linux support and limitations for heterogeneous processor handling
Documentation of specific problems encountered when adding heterogeneous support to PAPI
Solutions for performance counter measurement across heterogeneous core types
Infrastructure enabling performance analysis on hybrid ARM and x86 processors

metrics.other: Performance measurement coverage and accuracy across heterogeneous core types

primary_theme: Performance measurement infrastructure for heterogeneous processors
